description: 국가철도공단_역사별 물품보관함 현황 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 이와 같이 해당 데이터는 철도 운영기관이 편의 시설을 효과적으로 관리하고 승객 만족도를 높일 수 있도록 지원하는 실질적인 공공 인프라 데이터로서 높은 활용 가치를 지니고 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 물품보관함, 물품보관함위치, 역사편의시설, 이용편의정보, 보관함현황. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
